parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
